A span ending here ended because nobody has said anything since, which is not the same claim as the output having been switched off - so a wave drawn from these spans stops here rather than running flat along the bottom to the edge.

metric.description: The reading the rule watched; null for an alert the health loop raised without one, or one from a rule watching an output.

shown.description: How many are in `events`. Zero on a shared or public read, whose rail is the grow's diary and never a device's diagnostics.

total.description: How many the window held. Equal to `shown` wherever the net did not bite, which is every short window.

frames.description: Oldest first, at most one per step, so the still above the panels is a lookup rather than a request per position.

growId.description: The grow the bands and the day counter are of; null in a space nothing grows in.

dayFrom.description: The grow's own day counter at each end of the window, which is the "day 33–34" beside the range chips.

stepSeconds.description: The window each point summarises; 0 in a space with no device to read, where there are no points at all.

deviceIds.description: Null on a shared or public read: what a reader is shown is the tent, not the hardware in it.

lastReadingAt.description: When a device standing here last measured one of the panels' metrics, whenever that was - which is the only thing that tells a window nothing was heard in apart from a place where nothing measures, since `panels` is empty in both. Answered only where `panels` is empty, because that is the one question it settles; null there where nothing standing here has ever measured, and null beside panels that speak for themselves.

nights.description: When the light was off, from the light output rather than from the clock; empty where no device reports one.

events.description: The rail: the diary of this space and of the grows standing in it, oldest first, as the marks are drawn.

grows.description: Every grow that has stood in this space, newest first, which is what the two stretch chips may be pointed at - a grow that moved out in spring left its record behind and the rail is the only screen that carries it. Empty on a shared or public read, which is given one grow and is not told what else has stood in the room.

readingNames.description: What the grows those lines belong to call their measurements, so a reading is named rather than keyed. On a read through a link, only the grows that stood here inside its window.

people.description: Everyone the rail names, so a mark can say who wrote it without another read.

dayAverage.description: The mean over the windows in which the light was on.

stage.description: The stage the grow entered on this day, where it entered one; null on a day it carried on in the stage before. A week is named after the stage it ended in, so this is the only place a card records a stage that began and was over inside it.

stageWeek.description: 1 in the week the stage began; null before the first phase.

deviceIds.description: The controllers the averages were read from. Empty where nothing measures in the places the grow stood, which a card says rather than drawing dashes; null on a shared or public read, where the averages are the diary and the hardware behind them is not.

lightHours.description: Hours of light per day over the week, from the controller’s light output.

days.description: Seven; a day that has not happened yet carries no picture.

feeding.description: Null for a grow that is fed no scheme.

entries.description: The week’s diary lines, newest first, capped; `entryCount` is how many there are.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last one.

dayTo.description: Null while the phase is the one the grow is in, which is what "→ today" says.

spaceIds.description: Where the plants stood during it, in the order they arrived; null on a shared or public read, which is told the story and not the address.

coverMediaId.description: The still nearest the middle of the phase, which is the chapter’s picture.

lightHours.description: Hours of light per day over the phase, from the controller’s light output, as a week card states it for its own seven days; null over a stretch too short or too quiet to say.

inBandPercent.description: The share of the phase in which every metric with a target sat inside `TARGET_BAND`; null where nothing held a target.

training.description: What was done to the plants in this phase, oldest first - "topped d18 · LST d20".

photoCount.description: Pictures the diary’s lines point at, of whatever kind those lines are; a diary kept before there was a photo tile carries them on its notes.

phases.description: Newest first, which is the order the chapters are read in.

people.description: Everyone the chapters name, so an entry can say who wrote it without another read.

plantId.description: Null for a reading about the grow rather than about one plant.

key.description: Names one of the grow’s `measurements[]`, which is where its name, its unit and its target are.

stepSeconds.description: The window each climate and output point summarises; 0 where no device was read at all.

originAt.description: The instant day 1 of this grow began, which is what day-of-grow counts from.

deviceIds.description: The devices the climate and the outputs were read from: whatever stood where the grow stood.

lastReadingAt.description: When a device standing where this grow stood last measured one of the climate metrics, whenever that was - which is the only thing that tells a window nothing was heard in apart from a place where nothing measures, since `climate` is empty in both. The Timeline of the tent answers the same question the same way. Answered only where `climate` is empty, because that is the one question it settles; null there where nothing standing with the grow has ever measured, and null beside curves that speak for themselves.

nights.description: When the light was off, which is what every panel is shaded by.

growId.description: The grow itself, which is what a reader follows. Only a diary at its own public address carries it - the same id its author’s profile already lists - and a link onto a diary that is not public carries none, because a link is a window and not a subscription.

stageWeek.description: Which week of the stage above the diary is in, counted against the grow’s own weeks exactly as the week cards below count them - the same figure `summary.stageWeek` answers the owner. It is here because it cannot be worked out from `dayNumber`: that gives the week of the whole grow, which is the week cards’ own heading and a different number entirely once a grow has changed stage. Null where the grow has entered no phase, and, like the day number and the stage, counted up to the end of the reader’s window rather than to today.

weeksCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to the weeks route of the same address for the weeks before these; null where the page holds them all.

nextCursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last one.

imageUrl.description: Absolute URL of the rendered card, for `og:image`.
